intro: Three pieces of onde-onde have about 120 kcal (estimate). Most of it comes from the glutinous rice flour and the gula melaka filling.
diet: Yes. Onde-onde is one of the lighter kuih if you watch how many you eat. Three pieces is around 120 kcal, fine for a tea-time snack. The problem is they're small and easy to pop one after another without noticing. Decide how many you'll have before you start.
tips: Put 2-3 pieces on a plate and keep the rest in the container.
Have it with teh O or plain water so you don't add more sugar.
Eat it after something with protein, like a boiled egg, to feel fuller.

swap.name: 2 pieces onde-onde + teh O kosong
swap.why: You still get that satisfying burst of gula melaka, with fewer calories.

faq.q: Are onde-onde and buah melaka the same?
faq.a: Yes, same kuih. In some places it's called buah melaka because of the gula melaka inside.

faq.q: Why does my onde-onde burst when boiling?
faq.a: Usually the dough is too dry or there's too much filling. Add a little water to the dough and seal the balls properly.

faq.q: How do I keep the grated coconut from spoiling so fast?
faq.a: Steam the grated coconut with a pinch of salt before using it. It helps the kuih last a little longer.
